parsed.name: 可编程交流电源
parsed.description: 用于实验室中输出并调节交流电的电源设备，可设置电压、频率、电流限制以及输出开关，常用于供电测试、交流输入模拟和电源设备验证。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory AC power source used to generate and control AC output. It supports setting voltage, frequency, current limit, and output on/off, and is commonly used for power input simulation, supply testing, and validation of AC-powered equipment.
